editorial:
Imagine finding a bag with 100 thousand dollars just sitting there. That is exactly what happens to three strippers from Detroit who decide to quit their jobs and head west to start their own club in California. You get a wild ride as these girls try to live the high life, but there is a huge catch. The money actually belongs to a scary mob boss who does not take kindly to being robbed. The vibe is a total blast, mixing fish-out-of-water comedy with the constant fear that the bad guys are right around the corner.

You will love the chemistry between the three leads, as their friendship feels real and funny. While the plot is pretty simple and some of the jokes are a bit dated, the pacing keeps you moving. If you enjoy goofy crime comedies from the late 90s, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: In the end, the mob boss finally catches up to the girls in California. Just when it looks like they are in big trouble, the girls use their wits and some help from new friends to outsmart him. They manage to get rid of the mobster for good and keep enough money to actually make their dream club a reality. It wraps up with them successfully owning their own business and living their best lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy 90s comedies and underdog stories.
